releases.body:
The release workflow now verifies the published npm package name, version, commit, tarball SHA512, and latest tag before creating a GitHub release. npm HTTP logging is enabled to diagnose accepted uploads that are not yet publicly available.

All validation jobs in [Release 41734491862](https://github.com/poe-platform/poe-code/actions/runs/41734491862) passed. npm accepted this upload with HTTP 202, but the immediate metadata request returned 404, so the release step correctly failed. The public package and latest tag have now been verified at commit `27cf01f6cfad691097061196b3698a72f85f06b0`, including tarball integrity and packaged `halo-alpha` support. This GitHub release completes that accepted upload; the npm package was not republished.

[Changes since v18.0.17](https://github.com/poe-platform/poe-code/compare/v18.0.17...v18.0.18)
